notes: Tuition: only the general 'Bachelor's degree programmes - The University of Buckingham' fee of 4,000 EUR per semester is stated; the page does not explicitly say it applies to this programme or to non-EU/EEA students, so the human auditor should confirm. Intake: the 30 September 2026 deadline is for the September intake and the page does not explicitly state it applies to non-EU applicants. Documents: only the secondary school leaving certificate is named; other documents may be required but are not named. There is no language proficiency requirement for French, only English (IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 72 equivalent).
